_comment_permissions: Declarative allow/deny for common cases, checked before Claude Code even reaches a tool call. This complements, not replaces, the hooks below: hooks can inspect the actual command text (e.g. distinguishing 'terraform plan' from 'terraform apply'), which a static permission rule cannot. Keep both — a denied-by-permission action never even reaches the hook, which is a faster and more legible first line of defense for the clear-cut cases below.
_comment_mcpServers: See docs/mcp-servers.md for recommended MCP servers (GitHub, read-only Postgres, Slack) and example configuration to add under an 'mcpServers' key here. None are wired by default.
